title: ProductQuantityRule - Data API
description: Represents the relationship between a quantity rule and a product. This object assigns quantity rules to a product. This object is available in API version 51.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The ISO code for the currency that’s specified on the buyer’s account. This field is exposed in orgs that have multicurrency enabled. Default value is USD. Possible values are: EUR—Euro USD—U.S. Dollar

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Name of the product quantity rule.

ProductId.description: ID of the product. This field is a relationship field.

PurchaseQuantityRuleId.description: ID of the related purchase quantity rule. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: The ProductQuantityRule object is available only if the B2B Commerce license or Automotive Cloud license is enabled.
